claim: Silverstein has said in multiple interviews that on the morning of September 11, 2001 he was at a dermatologist appointment at his wife's insistence, missing his customary breakfast at Windows on the World atop the North Tower. His own account: "So that morning, I was dressing to get downtown to meet with one of the tenants, and my wife said: 'You can't go.' And I said: 'Why? I have an appointment downtown.' She said: 'Because I made an appointment for you with a dermatologist, and that's something you canceled last month and you cannot cancel again.'" Two of his children were not away from the complex that morning. Roger and Lisa Silverstein both worked for Silverstein Properties in temporary offices on the 88th floor of the North Tower, were running late, and reached his Midtown office on foot hours later covered in dust; he did not know whether they had survived until then. The account of the appointment rests on Silverstein's own telling, and no contemporaneous medical or appointment record has been published.
